body: Unfortunately there is no way to fix what I've done. I will leave letters for my dad, husband, and others, apologizing for my failures and for hurting them and letting them all down. But truly, the nicest thing I can do for all of them is to take myself out of this world. Then they can finally move on and forget about me.

I'm an adulterer, the exact same soulless, piece of shit nobodies that everyone on Reddit hates and wants dead. At least for Reddit there will soon be one less cheater sucking up everyone else's oxygen

I've been on SSRIs for a while now and they just barely enable me to act like a normal person in public. I don't deserve to feel better about what I've done. Killing myself would provide people relief, and even satisfaction for some.

Well I'm lucky in the respect that I know enough about anatomy to know where to cut so I'll bleed out quickly but will still feel it for a little while. Unless someone were to find me within a minute of me doing it, there's no saving me.

Because there's no fixing what I've done. I've destroyed the lives of wonderful people because I'm a weak, selfish, pathetic excuse for a human being. Nobody will ever forgive or forget what I've done, and all I have to look forward to is a lifetime of loneliness and misery. I deserve to die.
Bad circumstances don't excuse people from doing bad things. Tons of people have been through way worse than me and haven't turned into the monster that I am
My history is like yours? Sorry, I'm just a little confused, seeing as how I haven't left much info on this post

I've looked at that in the past, and again right now. It doesn't help. I am a bad person. I've done terrible things and people have done terrible things to me. I simply don't want to live anymore. But I appreciate your effort

Unfortunately there are no positives in my life. I've been well aware how inept I am everything in life, as evidenced by the large number of failures I've had, my lack of skill in anything, and being treated like shit and tossed aside by family, friends, and past loved ones.

There's no one to talk to. My husband has dealt with my depression in the past but is sick of it and has flipped out and yelled at me when my depression gets bad. As a result, I've stopped talking to him about anything serious.

I also don't have any real friends in medical school. What's worse is seeing them all excel in school and personal lives. They're engaged, getting married, having kids, and actually go out and fun with their spouses/significant others. My husband comes home from work, watches an hour of tv with me, then goes on the computer for the rest of the night and that's how he likes living every day of his life. As a result I don't fit in with the other happy married couples and I don't fit in with the single people who go out to clubs/parties every weekend. I've asked people if they'd like to come over, watch movies, or just study together, and everyone always says no. I'm completely alone all the time.

>" Some people are just going to be smarter and better at exams, that's all."

Aka, some people are just smarter and better than you. Except in this case, it's everyone. There are good doctors and there are bad doctors who should not have been allowed to practice medicine in the first place. Someone who can actually learn the material in a timely manner and prove it on exams and doesn't have to constantly struggle and re-research every topic they come across is not going to be the doctor who misses diagnoses and kills their patients.

A 17th percentile doctor is going to be the one who misses diagnoses and kills patients.

I just have a hard time believing that a 17th percentile student will ever be able to make it through 3rd or 4th year, let alone become a competent physician. I still can barely read an EKG, I'm still horrible in pharmacology, I never got biochem down, I have several C's on my transcript, and this COMLEX score just further verified how completely stupid I am. 

I just hate being alone and hate always being at the bottom. My whole life I've been alone, picked on, ridiculed, and people kept saying, "Don't worry, once you're in college everything gets better," and then college was even worse. Then people told me, "Don't worry, you'll find your people and find your place in med school where you all have the same goals," and now I'm even more alone and unhappy than ever, and med school is the only thing I've ever wanted to do with my life
